note: The S arm of every h2h suite: `sanchopanza install --path <user>/settings.json --write <flags>` from a frozen copy of `source` at `commit`, plus `env` in the claude process. Unsealed, the runners refuse --live. Sealed by the owner's session (2026-10-06 12:00) with the full line, e.g. --memory --guard --find --find-auto --skill --candor --scan-content --check-done --crawl --prune --fetch --knowledge, and the SANCHOPANZA_* of the best versions. Empty flags and a null source give the default install of this worktree's HEAD (the GAIA dev phase of 2026-10-05).
